page_note: 页面上半部是EIU《Industry outlook 2025》的正文两栏文字与一幅无编号折线图「Wind and solar are taking over」(六种电源2023–2033发电量, GWh, 数值轴在右侧), 下半部是新章节标题与正文。

heading.title: Wind and solar are taking over

components.evidence: the only value scale, 12,000 down to 0, is printed along the right edge of the plot
faint horizontal rules at 12,000/10,000/8,000/6,000/4,000/2,000/0; no vertical rules between year ticks
two-column legend 'Coal Gas / Solar Wind / Hydro Nuclear' sits in the left side column level with the plot
'Power generation by source; GWh' above the legend; right-hand ticks are bare numbers 12,000...0
'Source: EIU.' with 'Copyright © The Economist Intelligence Unit 2024. All rights reserved.' below it

new_components.name: unnumbered_figure
new_components.evidence: no 'Figure n' or 'Chart n' anywhere near the heading 'Wind and solar are taking over'
new_components.why_it_matters: 表格行无法用图号定位, 只能靠标题文字作为上下文键, 抽取时易与正文标题混淆。

new_components.name: copyright_line_below_source
new_components.evidence: 'Copyright © The Economist Intelligence Unit 2024. All rights reserved.' printed under 'Source: EIU.'
new_components.why_it_matters: 图下小字有两块, 解析器可能把版权行当作注释或数据说明, 干扰对源行的识别。

new_components.name: crossing_line_bundle
new_components.evidence: Solar, Wind, Hydro and Nuclear lines cross one another between 2029 and 2031 in a 2,000–4,500 band
new_components.why_it_matters: 交叉区内四条线相距不足半格(1,000 GWh), 逐系列取值时极易串线, 影响读数归属。

difficulty_notes: 数值轴每格2,000 GWh, 全图高约286像素, 即1像素≈60 GWh, 而图上无任何数据标签、无点标记。对下方束(Solar/Wind/Hydro/Nuclear, 1,200–4,400)来说, 5%容差在3,700时只有±185 GWh, 折合约3像素; 而四条2px粗线在2029–2031区间彼此相距仅几像素并相互交叉, 逐年读数几乎无法稳定落在容差内。相比之下行标签只需「系列+年份」两个键, 图例六项与11个年份刻度都逐个印出, 定位并不难; 因此瓶颈在像素读值。

suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中的value_axis_side, 允许在折线图上把唯一刻度列放到绘图区右缘
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 「值轴位于右侧 vs 左侧」一行: 比较解析器把右缘刻度与线端对齐的成功率

suggestions.what_to_add: P7的heading拆分, 特别是placement=beside与空figure_number
suggestions.where_to_change: 图题记录: number/title/subtitle/unit分列, 且heading块可放在与绘图区并列的左侧栏
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 「标题+图例位于侧栏且无图号 vs 标题在上方带图号」一行

suggestions.what_to_add: legend_beside_plot(图例作为侧栏两列排布)
suggestions.where_to_change: 布局条件行的legend_position增加beside_left, 并支持图例分两列
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 「图例在侧栏 vs 图例在下方」对六系列折线的系列名归属一行

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件crossing_line_bundle(多线在窄带内交叉)
suggestions.where_to_change: 折线生成器的数据条件: 允许4条系列在小于1格的值域内互相交叉
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 「线间距<0.5刻度格 vs >1刻度格」一行, 使可读性成为每个标记的精度上限
